title: perf(canary): auto-detect perf regressions and add rollout guards
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds automated detection for latency/throughput regressions in perf canaries and introduces rollout guards to prevent unsafe rollouts. Backwards-compatible.
description: Context: Our perf canary pipeline runs continuous latency and throughput checks against typical production workloads, but regressions are currently surfaced only as alerts; rollouts still proceed unless manually stopped. Motivation: reduce blast radius from subtle regression trends (e.g. +5-10% P95 latency) by automatically flagging and preventing risky rollouts and providing deterministic guard criteria. What this PR does: 1) Implements an automated regression detector that compares canary vs baseline distributions using bootstrap confidence intervals and relative thresholds. 2) Adds a rollout_guard service that evaluates canary results and enforces policies (block, warn, or auto-rollback) based on configurable thresholds and windowed trend detection. 3) Integrates detector outputs with the rollout controller and the console UI (dashboard flags + explanation text). 4) Adds a lightweight feature flag (perf_canary_auto_block) gated behind the experiments service for gradual enablement. Design notes: - Detector computes P50/P95/throughput deltas and estimates significance via bootstrap sampling over recent N canary runs (default N=20). - Policy rules support absolute and relative thresholds, min-sample-size guards, and a severity score to choose block vs warn. - Rollout controller now queries the rollout_guard API before each canary step and will abort on 'block' unless the policy is manually overridden. - Backwards compatible: if the feature flag is off, behavior is unchanged. Testing and CI: added unit tests for detector statistics, end-to-end integration test that simulates a 8% P95 regression, and a perf-check job that runs a small synthetic workload in CI (opt-in, runs on merge). Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation and unit tests - [x] Rollout guard API and controller integration - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Console flag + explanation copy - [x] End-to-end regression test - [x] Documentation: design doc link and admin guide (see related files) Related: ENG-4523 (perf canary improvements), ENG-4680 (rollout automation). Migration/ops: ops should add the new policy defaults to the org config; default is 'warn' for low-severity regressions and 'block' for high-severity or sustained regressions. Implementation is feature-flagged to allow staged rollout across customers. Notes for reviewers: focus on detector statistical assumptions (bootstrap window size and sampling), rollback semantics in the controller, and the safety of the default policy.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice work. A couple of questions on the bootstrap approach - did you consider stratified sampling to account for varying sequence length distributions?
Priya Shah: We added a stratification key (seq_len_bin) in the latest detector commit to ensure like-for-like comparisons; details in detector.py comments.
Luca Romano: Controller change looks reasonable, but we should ensure the abort path emits the same audit events as manual aborts (for SLO incident correlation).
Priya Shah: Added audit event emission and a unit test that verifies audit fields. See controller.py + tests.
Ava Mitchell: CI perf-check is flaky on x86 runners - I re-ran the job once; recommend making the synthetic workload deterministic or marking it as allowed-flaky.
Priya Shah: Made the workload deterministic by seeding RNG and reduced variance; added a retry wrapper in the CI job.
Ethan Park: Approved after addressing comments - good catch on audit events and feature flag gating.
merge_details: Merged by Ava Mitchell after 2 approvals and green CI. Squashed 6 commits.
summary: Automated detection for perf canaries plus rollout guards to block/warn/rollback on statistically significant regressions; feature-flagged and back-compatible.
notes_for_ops: Add 'perf_canary_auto_block' feature flag to customer orgs when ready. Default policy file updated in infra/feature-flags/defaults.yaml. Monitor new metrics rollout_guard.block_count and detector.significance_score.
testing_notes: E2E test simulates a sustained +8% P95 regression across 5 consecutive canaries to validate auto-block behavior. Added unit tests for bootstrap CI coverage.
